source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the female reproductive system (PDF 77-79).

blocks.text: Zanana tolidi nizam gonads (ovaries), oviducts, uterus (rahim) aur vagina par mushtamil hai; oviducts, uterus aur vagina is ke madadgar aaza hain.

items: Ovaries: do bayzavi ovaries, 3 se 5 cm lambi aur 2 se 3 cm chauri, rahim ke dono taraf, anday ke cells (ova ya oocytes) aur hormones banati hain. In ki functional units nanhi theliyan, ovarian follicles, hain jo kachche andon ki parwarish karti hain. Baligh mein har mahine aik pakta follicle apna anda chhorta hai (ovulation), aur phata follicle glandular corpus luteum ban jata hai.

Oviducts (Fallopian ya uterine tubes): ovaries se rahim tak do nalyan. Chhoota ovum oviduct mein dakhil hota aur teh ke cilia use rahim ki taraf le jate hain. Fertilization oviduct mein hota aur zygote wahin mitosis se taqseem shuru karta hai.

Uterus: khokhla muscular uzv jis ka fundus (oviducts ke surakhon ke oopar gol hissa), body (asal hissa) aur cervix (neeche ka tang hissa jo vagina mein khulta) hai. Is ki deewar mein bahar patla perimetrium, beech mein smooth muscle ka mota myometrium aur andar spongy endometrium hai jis ki basal teh ke stem cells use dobara banate aur functional teh har haiz ke chakkar mein moti ho kar jharti hai; hamal mein yeh mazeed moti hoti, janeen jur jata aur is ki khoon wali jagahein mil kar placenta banati hain jo janeen aur foetus ko oxygen aur ghiza deta hai.
Vagina: bahar se cervix tak 8 se 10 cm lambi patli deewar wali nali; bachche ki paidaish aur haiz ke bahao ka raasta.

blocks.alt: Zanana tolidi aaza ka saada saamne ka khaaka: nashpati-numa rahim (uterus) jis ka oopar gol fundus, body aur tang cervix hai, aur deewar teen tahon mein (perimetrium, muscular myometrium aur andar endometrium); do mure hue oviducts jin ke jhalardar sire do ovaries ke paas hain, jin mein follicles hain; aur cervix se neeche jati vagina.
blocks.caption: Insani zanana tolidi nizam (Figure 17.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ovaries anday aur hormones banati hain; un ke follicles andon ki parwarish karte, aur har mahine aik pakka follicle apna anda chhorta (ovulation) aur corpus luteum ban jata hai. Oviducts ke cilia anday ko rahim ki taraf le jate hain, aur fertilization oviduct mein hota hai. Rahim ka fundus, body aur cervix hai; is ki deewar mein bahar perimetrium, mota muscular myometrium aur andar endometrium hai jis ki functional teh har chakkar mein moti hoti aur jhar jati hai aur hamal mein placenta banane mein madad deti hai. Vagina, 8 se 10 cm lambi, cervix se bahar tak jati hai.

blocks.text: Anday banne ka amal paidaish se pehle shuru hota hai: follicles ke oogonia (2n) mitosis se primary oocytes (2n) banate jo meiosis I shuru kar ke prophase I mein ruk jate aur poore bachpan, kam az kam 10 se 14 saal, wahin rehte hain. Paidaish par ovaries mein taqreeban 20 lakh follicles hote hain, har aik mein aik primary oocyte. Balooghat se aik waqt mein aik primary oocyte meiosis I dobara shuru kar ke do na-barabar haploid cells banata hai: bara secondary oocyte (1n) aur chhota pehla polar body (1n). Secondary oocyte metaphase II mein ruk kar ovulation par chhoota hai. Fertilize na ho to mar jata; sperm us se mil jaye to oviduct mein foran meiosis II poori kar ke aik bara ovum (1n) aur chhota doosra polar body (1n) banata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: spermatogenesis cells ki zanjeer ki shakal mein: germline cell (2n), spermatogonium (2n), primary spermatocyte (2n), meiosis I se do secondary spermatocytes (1n), meiosis II se chaar spermatids (1n) aur chaar sperms, neeche sperm ka sar, acrosome, midpiece aur dum. Daen: oogenesis: oogonium (2n), balooghat tak prophase I mein ruka primary oocyte (2n), meiosis I se secondary oocyte aur pehla polar body, aur sperm dakhil ho to meiosis II se aik ovum aur doosra polar body.
blocks.caption: Oogenesis (Figure 17.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Testis mein germline cells mitosis se taqseem hote; kuch spermatogonia bante jo primary spermatocytes banate; har primary spermatocyte meiosis I se do secondary spermatocytes aur meiosis II se chaar spermatids banata, jo sar (nucleus aur acrosome), midpiece (mitochondria aur centriole) aur dum wale sperms ban jate hain. Ovary mein oogonia paidaish se pehle primary oocytes banate jo prophase I mein ruk jate hain; balooghat se aik aik kar ke meiosis I poori kar ke bara secondary oocyte aur chhota pehla polar body banta hai; metaphase II mein ruka secondary oocyte ovulation par chhoota aur sirf sperm dakhil hone par meiosis II poori kar ke aik ovum aur doosra polar body banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ovulation par ovary se asal mein kaunsa cell chhoota hai?
blocks.explanation: Metaphase II mein ruka secondary oocyte; yeh sirf sperm dakhil hone par ovum banta hai.

items: Ovaries (follicles, ovulation, corpus luteum), oviducts (cilia, fertilization), uterus (fundus, body, cervix; perimetrium, myometrium, endometrium), vagina.
Oogenesis: oogonium, primary oocyte (balooghat tak prophase I), secondary oocyte + pehla polar body, fertilization ke baad ovum + doosra polar body.
